EMERGENCY PROCEDURES:

ELECTRIC SHOCK / ELECTROCUTION:

1. De-energize source if possible (if safe to do so)

2. If cannot de-energize, use non-conductive material to separate victim

3. Call for emergency medical assistance immediately

4. Check breathing and pulse - begin CPR if trained

5. Treat for shock - keep victim warm and lying down

6. Do not move victim unless in danger of further injury

ARC FLASH / BURN:

1. Stop - Drop - Roll if clothing on fire

2. Cool burns with cool water for at least 10 minutes

3. Cover burns with clean, dry cloth

4. Seek immediate medical attention

5. Do not apply ointments or ice directly to burns

FIRE:

1. Raise alarm - Call fire department

2. Use appropriate fire extinguisher (Class C for electrical fires)

3. Evacuate area if fire is uncontrollable

4. Do not use water on electrical fires
